correctness.rationale: The cyclic proof is correct. With h the common support-difference gcd and n=N/h, indicator-mask zeros occur exactly at the two nonzero order-three difference classes when 3 divides n and the primitive support meets all three residues modulo 3. Any three-point spectrum must therefore be one coset of that order-three subgroup, with independent h-fold lifts. The exact number of spectra is N times h squared divided by 3. Fresh bounded replay for all triples in cyclic groups of orders 3 through 18 reproduced the criterion and count.
